description: This file defines the 'Scripting' module for HTMLPurifier, responsible for handling scripting elements such as <script> and <noscript> in HTML documents. It includes class definitions, element setup, and configuration for safe or unsafe scripting content.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Scripting
classes.description: Defines a scripting module for HTMLPurifier that manages <script> and <noscript> elements, including their validation attributes and content models.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes element definitions and attribute transformations for the scripting module, configuring safe scripting options and content models.
